title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 05:28:50 最新章节：番外假如朔衡变成反派12
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
当朔衡再次睁开眼时，对眼前的情况颇有些不解。
这……地府原来是长这样的？
他清楚的记得，自己在做完一台耗时长达十六个小时的手术后，因为心脏骤停而倒在了手术室冰冷的地面上。
这一倒，就再也没能醒来。
所以他应该是死了？
但一向奉行科学的朔衡怎么也没想到，自己竟然在去世以后真的见到了传说中的‘阴曹地府’。
只是这‘地府’，放眼望去竟是一片漆黑，连一丝光亮也无。
按照流程，他应该喝一碗孟婆汤，然后走过奈何桥去投胎了吧？
可是这‘奈何桥’究竟在哪儿？他是真的看不清。
“有人吗？”朔衡想了想，觉得还是赶紧投胎比傻站在这里要强，“或者……有鬼吗？劳驾给指个路。”
【叮。】
一道突兀的铃声在朔衡耳边响起，他顺着声音蓦然回首，就看见自己的身后正飘着一颗发光的球。
朔衡沉默了一下：“你这小玩意儿是什么？”
【叮，系统004号，竭诚为您服务。】
发光的球上下颤动了一番，然后操着一口流畅的机械音在朔衡的脑海中讲话。
【您好，宿主。】
朔衡并不是一个没看过小说的人，无聊的时候，看看某些脑洞大开的小说还是挺有意思的，关键问题在于——朔衡从没想过这一幕会发生在自己身上。
就很有趣。
“来，咱聊聊吧，小系统，你是什么来路？”
【￥%#*主系统管辖之下的004号系统，与宿主绑定后，共同完成任务维护世界稳定。】

朔衡听着前面那一串乱码，挑了挑眉：“再说一遍，什么主系统？”
【宿主，目前您权限不足，听到的只能是乱码。】
朔衡没有强求：“好吧。所以你的意思就是我以后要跟你一起给你们的主系统打工？”
【是的，宿主。】
“为什么选我？”
面对这个问题，004把自己知道的全盘托出。
【主系统在招收任务员之前作出规定，必须任务员本身的资质达到一定分数以上才能被选中。
宿主，您的资质检测报告是九十九分，已经超过了约等于百分之百的任务者。】
“约等于百分之百？”朔衡思索片刻，觉得大概是因为有人跟他的评分一样的缘故，“好吧，那跟我说说当任务者都有什么好处？”
004立刻如数家珍。
【您可以在主系统管辖区域内拥有一套永久存在的固定房产，并且每结束一个任务都有假期。
拥有极为漫长的寿命。
content_en:
When Shuo Heng opened his eyes again, he was quite puzzled by the situation in front of him.
This...the underworld turns out to be like this?
He clearly remembered that after completing an operation that took up to sixteen hours, he collapsed on the cold floor of the operating room due to cardiac arrest.
After falling down, he never woke up again.
So he should be dead?
But Shuo Heng, who has always pursued science, never expected that he would actually see the legendary 'Underworld' after his death.
It's just that this 'underworld' is pitch black as far as the eye can see, without even a trace of light.
According to the procedure, he should drink a bowl of Meng Po soup, then walk across the Naihe Bridge to be reincarnated, right?
But where is this ‘Naihe Bridge’? He really couldn't see clearly.
"Is there anyone there?" Shuo Heng thought for a moment and felt that it would be better to reincarnate quickly rather than just stand here. "Or...is there a ghost? Could you please give me some directions?"
[Ding. 】
A sudden ringtone rang in Shuo Heng's ears. Following the sound, he suddenly looked back and saw a glowing ball floating behind him.
Shuo Heng was silent for a moment: "What is this gadget of yours?"
[Ding, system number 004, we are here to serve you wholeheartedly. 】
The glowing ball trembled up and down, and then spoke a smooth mechanical voice in Shuo Heng's mind.
[Hello, host. 】
Shuo Heng is not a person who has never read novels. When he is bored, it is quite interesting to read some imaginative novels. The key problem is that Shuo Heng never thought that this scene would happen to him.
It's just fun.
"Come, let's talk, little system, where are you from?"
[￥%#* System No. 004 under the jurisdiction of the main system, after being bound to the host, jointly completes tasks to maintain world stability. 】
Shuo Heng raised his eyebrows when he heard the string of garbled characters in front of him: "Tell me again, what is the main system?"
[Host, you currently have insufficient permissions, so all you hear are garbled characters. 】
Shuo Heng didn't force it: "Okay. So what you mean is that I will work with you on your main system in the future?"
[Yes, host. 】
"Why choose me?"
Faced with this problem, 004 told everything he knew.
[The main system stipulates before recruiting task workers that the qualifications of the task workers must reach a certain score or above before they can be selected.
Host, your qualification test report is 99 points, which has exceeded approximately 100% of task takers. 】
"About 100%?" Shuo Heng thought for a moment and felt that it was probably because someone had the same rating as him. "Okay, then tell me what are the benefits of being a taskmaster?"
004 immediately became a treasure trove.
[You can have a permanent set of fixed real estate within the jurisdiction of the main system, and you will have a vacation after completing a task.
Has an extremely long lifespan.
